# Cale AI Workbench 0.24.11 for Windows

Create Song now displays a cyan waveform with a moving scan line under “Checking the vocals”. It appears on the song being checked and clears when verification ends. The visual indicates activity during the local vocal check. People using reduced motion see a still waveform, and the status label is available to screen readers.

Tested on a one-minute vocal recording in the Windows release build. The scan appeared during vocal verification, moved between frames, respected a reduced-motion change, and cleared when the song completed. TypeScript, frontend packaging, permissions and binary asset checks passed.

Source commit 7375b1adb45755f532e230c60164d46779409bff.
